name: ai-website-clone-template
description: Clone any website into a clean, modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents
author: JCodesMore

scripts.test: node --test src/lib/carousel.test.ts src/lib/promo.test.ts src/lib/promo-settings.test.ts src/lib/product-finder.test.ts src/lib/related-products.test.ts src/lib/catalogue-taxonomy.test.ts src/lib/argentina-ar4-alibaba.test.ts src/lib/image-alt-overrides.test.ts src/lib/newsletter.test.ts src/lib/services.test.ts src/lib/events.test.ts src/lib/certifications-page.test.ts src/lib/cms-config.test.ts src/lib/editorial-image-uniqueness.test.ts src/lib/json-ld.test.ts src/lib/seo-policy.test.ts src/components/site/overlay-layering.test.ts src/components/site/short-marker.test.ts src/components/site/home-accent.test.ts src/components/site/product-image-zoom.test.ts src/components/site/header-shelf.test.ts
scripts.test:export: node --test src/components/site/static-export-performance.test.ts scripts/seo-audit.test.mjs && node scripts/audit-seo.mjs --check && npm run export:segments:check
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:export
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/generate-editorial-srcsets.mjs --check && node scripts/build-content-index.mjs && node scripts/build-search-index.mjs
scripts.deploy:prep: npm run build && npm run test:export && node scripts/predeploy-check.mjs
